title: The Wormhole
venue_description:
The Wormhole - Your Favorite Neighborhood Dive and Music Venue

The Wormhole Neighborhood Pub and Music Venue stands as one of Savannah's most authentic and beloved music destinations. Since opening in 2008 the venue has built a reputation for genuine dive bar character combined with professional music programming. Located at 2307 Bull Street in the Starland Design District The Wormhole functions as both neighborhood watering hole and serious music venue - a rare combination that creates community around live performance.

Voted Best Open Mic in Savannah

The Wormhole's Monday night open mic has earned recognition as the Best Open Mic in Savannah by Connect Savannah readers. Running from 8pm to 2:30am every Monday the open mic welcomes all musicians and all genres. The format accommodates solo acts and full bands with 10-15 minute sets for soloists and 15 minutes for bands. Performers can sign up multiple times throughout the night non-consecutively ensuring everyone gets stage time. The longest-running open mic in Savannah according to staff.

Professional Music Equipment and Services

The Wormhole provides full backline equipment including drums bass guitar and keyboard. This professional setup means musicians can perform without hauling equipment - just bring your instrument or voice. The venue employs experienced sound engineers who can provide live multi-track recordings of performances. Artists interested in recordings should text 912-507-3599 to register ahead. Extra instruments are available for use. The only restriction is no backing tracks without live musicians - all music must be performed live.

Diverse Music Programming

Beyond Monday open mics The Wormhole hosts jam sessions every other Wednesday from 8pm to 2:30am. These jam-only nights focus on spontaneous collaborative playing without the open mic sign-up format. Friday and Saturday nights feature concerts ranging from metal to swing to country to punk to electronic to flamenco and beyond. The eclectic booking policy reflects genuine commitment to supporting all musical genres and expressions. Touring bands routing through Savannah specifically stop at The Wormhole knowing they will find supportive audiences.

Authentic Dive Bar Character

The Wormhole proudly maintains dive bar authenticity without pretension. Dark space-themed decor creates visual interest while keeping the focus on music and community rather than fancy furnishings. Pool tables billiards pinball and darts provide entertainment beyond music. The venue describes itself as a casual place with artistic flair and charm where you can find all kinds of people of various styles ages and interests. Regular patrons describe the vibe as authentic and grunge with friendly folk.

Food and Drink

The kitchen is open late serving good fresh hot food. The bar offers great drinks and cocktails. Nothing is more sacred at The Wormhole than a Pabst Blue Ribbon according to staff - reflecting the dive bar ethos and accessible pricing. The combination of late-night food quality drinks and no cover charges for most events makes The Wormhole affordable and accessible. Hours run from noon to 2am Monday through Saturday providing extended service throughout the day and late into the night.

Community Focus and Atmosphere

What distinguishes The Wormhole from corporate entertainment venues is genuine community focus. The venue describes itself as your neighborhood watering hole and late night eatery. Regular customers become friends staff members know your name and the atmosphere emphasizes welcoming over exclusivity. Participants in open mics include newly formed bands professionals working on material musicians looking to jam touring artists and locals wanting to participate in Savannah's music scene. All are welcome and all are treated equally.

Starland Design District

Located in the Starland Design District south of Forsyth Park The Wormhole serves a neighborhood known for artists creative businesses and younger demographics. The venue sits near the intersection of Bull Street and 39th Street. We're the only thing in this area according to staff - making The Wormhole an essential gathering place for the neighborhood. The district has become increasingly vibrant with galleries studios and creative businesses alongside The Wormhole.

Age Policy and Accessibility

The venue is 18 and over. Under 21 attendees must leave their ID with door or bar staff and cannot drink before or during their visit. This policy allows younger musicians and music fans to participate while maintaining legal compliance. The age-accessible policy supports emerging artists who may not yet be 21 but deserve opportunities to perform and experience live music community.

Special Events and Comedy

Beyond music The Wormhole hosts stand-up comedy events adding variety to the entertainment calendar. The venue operates Sport's Pick'em and Trivia that patrons can play from home winning gift cards to use on future visits. These additional offerings demonstrate The Wormhole's commitment to being a full-service neighborhood gathering place rather than a single-purpose music venue.

Recognition and Awards

The Best Open Mic award from Connect Savannah validates what regular patrons already know - The Wormhole provides exceptional music community in Savannah. The recognition comes from actual participants and attendees rather than industry insiders reflecting genuine grassroots appreciation. The award and ongoing community support demonstrate that authentic venues built on genuine values rather than corporate formulas can thrive and earn recognition.

Position in Savannah's Music Ecosystem

Savannah has a growing live music scene with venues across the historic district and surrounding neighborhoods. The Wormhole occupies an essential niche as the dive bar with professional music programming - accessible and unpretentious yet serious about sound quality and artist support. This combination makes The Wormhole beloved by both musicians and audiences. For anyone seeking authentic Savannah music experience The Wormhole delivers genuine community and quality performance.
